puzzles.name: Central Pillar Water Level
puzzles.description: Manipulate water level to 3 positions (High, Medium, Low) using the central pillar mechanism to access different floors.
steps: Play Zelda's Lullaby at Triforce symbol
Water level cycles: High -> Medium -> Low
High: Access 2F rooms, Boss Key area
Medium: Access 1F main hall, central pillar
Low: Access B1, B2 basement areas
hints: Sheik: "The water level holds the key..."
Triforce symbol glows at each level

puzzles.name: Longshot Chest Puzzle
puzzles.description: Use Hookshot to reach Longshot chest in the rising water room. Requires precise water level timing.
steps: Hookshot to chest platform before submerged

puzzles.name: Cracked Wall Navigation
puzzles.description: Bomb cracked walls at different water levels to create shortcuts and access new areas.
steps: Bomb B1 cracked wall -> Shortcut to Central Pillar
Bomb 2F cracked wall -> Access to Dark Link room
Bomb B2 wall -> Access to Morpha corridor

puzzles.name: Dark Link Illusion Room
puzzles.description: Fight Dark Link in mirrored room. No Z-targeting. Use environment and timing.
hints: Dark Link waits for player attack

puzzles.name: Boss Key Whirlpool Puzzle
puzzles.description: Navigate whirlpools at Low water to reach Boss Key chest on central pillar.
steps: Dive to bottom with Iron Boots

puzzles.name: Morpha Corridor Water Tunnel
puzzles.description: Swim through underwater tunnel at High water to reach Morpha arena.
hints: Tunnel only accessible at High water

phases.name: Water Tentacles
phases.mechanic: Morpha creates water tentacles from pool, nucleus hidden in water
phases.vulnerability: Nucleus visible briefly when tentacles retract

phases.name: Tentacle Slam
phases.puzzle: Dodge slams, Longshot nucleus during recovery

phases.name: Whirlpool Form
phases.mechanic: Low health - Morpha creates whirlpool, pulls player
phases.puzzle: Iron Boots to resist pull, Longshot nucleus
